title: 第524章 击败力王
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

云峰因为今天睡觉起来晚了一点，所以来迟到了一点，一直到了现在才来到了这里。

“呵呵，云大人，你终于来了？”

看到云峰出现后，白虎开心死了，连忙过来握住了云峰的手，他很是激动。

云峰是白虎亲自去江北林家邀请来的，白虎知道云峰很强，他来这里一定可以击败诸多国外高手，当上神帝。

“哦，你就是江北口技王，我听说过你的名字，听说你一口气就能将人轰成血雾，或者将人轰飞出去，是不是真的？”

此刻，力王也看向了云峰，用生硬的中文说道。

哪怕力王在外国，也听过最近大夏国几年出现了一个了不起的人物，这个人物擅长一巴掌将人轰成血雾，或者嘴里吹口气杀人，外号血雾王、口技王，是非常厉害的存在。

本来力王这么厉害的人物应该是一个老头子才对，哪知道会这么年轻，他则有些疑问，眼前的这个年轻人真的有传说中那么强吗？

“天啊，他就是大夏国口技王云峰，没想到这么年轻这么帅啊。”

“是啊，他好英俊啊，腹肌好发达啊，好想给他生猴子。”

现场是有很多女武者的，在看到云峰如此年轻英俊后则动了心，议论起来，她们看向云峰的目光里都是小星星。

“毛国鬼子，滚下擂台吧，你不配当神帝。”

云峰则飞上了擂台，摸出了一根华子点燃了，他看着力王淡淡的道，语气狂妄。

云峰大老远来这里自然是为了当上神帝，接管地球的，神帝位置怎么能让毛国鬼子抢走，他可丢不起那个脸。

“呵呵，我不配，小子你果然很狂，和传说中的一样，很好，现在让我试试你的身体是不是和你嘴巴一样硬。”

听到云峰说他不配，力王被激怒了，他说出这番话来，然后抡起砂锅般大的拳头狠狠的朝着云峰的胸口轰了过来。

他的拳头狠狠的轰在了云峰的胸口，发出了洪钟大吕般的巨响。

可惜的是，云峰并没有被他一拳轰倒在地，云峰手里吊着一根华子，在抽烟。

他脸上一副云淡风轻的样子。

怎么可能？他的身体怎么这么硬？

力王惊呆了，刚才这一拳他可是直接使用了八成力量，就算是一辆钢铁坦克被这么来一下，也会被轰碎的。

连坦克都能轰碎，何况是人体，他不明白，为什么一拳不能轰死眼前的云峰。

“力气太小了，大力点。”

云峰对着眼前的力王吐出来一口烟雾，淡淡的道。

“好，我就不信轰不死你。”

力王怒道，用手从身上摸出一个小盒子，

当然这些菠菜不是普通的菠菜，而是力王炼制的一些特殊食物，里面添加了很多药物。

力王只要吃这些菠菜，就能提升自己的力量、敏捷、防御力等等，可以增幅自身的力量。

果然吃掉了菠菜后，力王的身体快速有了变化，手臂、大腿变长变粗。

不过几秒钟的功夫，就从一个一米九的身高，变成了一个身高接近3米，肌肉发达的巨汉。

因为身体变大，力王的衣衫裤子都破裂了，露出来毛茸茸的毛发，他身体肌肉虬结，看起来很恐怖。

而看到变形后的力王，诸多围观看热闹的吃瓜群众和武者都惊呆了，不敢相信。

“我的天啊，大力水手啊，吃菠菜就能变强变大？”

Yunfeng got up a little late because he went to bed today, so he came a little late, and he didn't get here until now.

"Haha, Master Yun, are you finally here?"

After seeing Yunfeng appear, Baihu was so happy that he quickly came over and held Yunfeng's hand. He was very excited.

Bai Hu personally invited Yun Feng to the Lin family in Jiangbei. Bai Hu knew that Yun Feng was very strong. He would definitely be able to defeat many foreign masters here and become the God Emperor.

"Oh, you are the ventriloquist king of Jiangbei. I have heard of your name. I heard that you can blast people into blood mist or fly them away with one breath. Is it true?"

At this moment, King Li also looked at Yunfeng and spoke in blunt Chinese.

Even if King Li is in a foreign country, he has heard that a remarkable figure has appeared in Daxia Kingdom in recent years. This figure is good at blowing people into blood mist with a slap, or killing people by blowing breath from his mouth. He is nicknamed the King of Blood Mist and the King of Ventriloquism. He is a very powerful existence.

Originally, a person as powerful as the King of Power should be an old man, but who knew he would be so young? He had some doubts, was the young man in front of him really as strong as the legend said?

"Oh my God, he is the ventriloquist king Yunfeng of Great Xia. I didn't expect him to be so young and handsome."

"Yes, he is so handsome and his abdominal muscles are so developed. I really want to give him a baby."

There were many female warriors at the scene. After seeing Yunfeng so young and handsome, they were moved and started talking. Their eyes were full of stars when they looked at Yunfeng.

"You devil from the Mao Kingdom, get off the ring. You are not worthy of being the God Emperor."

Yunfeng flew up to the ring, took out a flower stick and lit it. He looked at King Li and said calmly, with an arrogant tone.

Yunfeng naturally came all the way here to become the God Emperor and take over the earth. How could the Mao Kingdom's devils take away the position of God Emperor? He couldn't afford to lose face.

"Haha, I'm not worthy. Boy, you are really crazy, just like the legend says. Very good. Now let me try to see if your body is as hard as your mouth."

Hearing Yunfeng say that he was not worthy, King Li was enraged. He said these words, then raised his fist as big as a casserole and hit Yunfeng's chest hard.

His fist hit Yunfeng's chest hard, making a loud sound like a bell.

It was a pity that Yunfeng was not knocked to the ground by his punch. Yunfeng had a huazi hanging in his hand and was smoking.

There was a calm look on his face.

How is it possible?Why is his body so hard?

King Li was stunned. He had used 80% of his power in the punch just now. Even a steel tank would be shattered by this punch.

Even a tank could be blown to pieces, let alone a human body. He didn't understand why one punch couldn't kill Yunfeng in front of him.

"My strength is too weak, please be stronger."

Yunfeng exhaled a puff of smoke at the Li King in front of him and said calmly.

"Okay, I don't believe I can't kill you."

King Li said angrily and took out a small box from his body.

Of course, these spinach are not ordinary spinach, but some special food refined by King Li, with a lot of medicine added to it.

As long as the King of Power eats these spinach, he can improve his strength, agility, defense, etc., and increase his power.

Sure enough, after eating the spinach, King Li's body changed rapidly, and his arms and thighs became longer and thicker.

In just a few seconds, he went from a height of 1.9 meters to a muscular giant of nearly 3 meters.

As his body grew larger, King Li's clothes and pants were torn, revealing his furry hair, and his body muscles were tangled, making him look terrifying.

When they saw the transformed King of Power, many people and warriors who were watching the excitement were stunned and couldn't believe it.

"Oh my God, Popeye, you can become stronger and bigger by eating spinach?"
